listitem.para: Whether ipsec add --autoall (run when &pluto; starts and whenever ipsec.conf is reloaded) should reconcile the running connection table against the configuration rather than only adding to it. When enabled, a connection that --autoall loads and whose definition is unchanged is left in place, preserving its established SAs instead of being torn down and rebuilt. Any connections that --autoall does not load are swept away, including ones still named in ipsec.conf but skipped because of auto=ignore. When disabled, --autoall is additive only: removed connections linger and unchanged connections are re-added on every reload.
